headline: Approved Seaport Grant match funding, board reappointments, license renewals, and ordinance amendments while continuing utility underground-installation hearings to later dates.
summary: The Council held public hearings on National Grid and GONETSPEED petitions to install underground utility facilities, continuing most of them to February 17 or March 2, 2026, after one petition was withdrawn. Members approved a $137,500 fund transfer to match a Seaport Economic Grant, a $2,000 library donation, several board reappointments, two motor vehicle license renewals, a Home Rule Petition on the Police Chief's retirement age, Cabot Street easement grants, and first votes on dog kennel and animal control ordinance changes. The Council also set public hearings for budget transfers to the Dispatch Department and Recreation Enterprise fund and approved a salary increase for the Council's Budget Analyst by an 8-1 vote.
